1     
The diagram shows two shapes on a centimetre grid. 
Q
P
(a)  Find the area of shape P
(b)  Write down the mathematical name for shape Q.
 
(c)  Find the area of shape Q. 
(3 marks)

2     
The length of a rectangle is two times the width of the rectangle. 
The perimeter of the rectangle is 24 cm.
Draw the rectangle on a centimetre grid. 
(2 marks)

3     
The length of a rectangle is three times the width of the rectangle. 
The area of the rectangle is 48 cm 2. 
Draw the rectangle on a centimetre grid. 
(2 marks)

4     
The base of a triangle is twice the height of the triangle. 
The area of a triangle is 16 cm 2.
Draw the triangle on a centimetre grid. 
(2 marks)

5     
The base of a parallelogram is twice the perpendicular height of the 
parallelogram. 
The area of the parallelogram is 50 cm 2. 
Draw the parallelogram on a centimetre grid. 
(2 marks)

7     
A square has an area of 64 cm 2.

8     
A square has a perimeter of 36 cm. 
Find the area of the square. 
(2 marks)

9     
The diagram shows a right angled triangle and a parallelogram.
10     The diagram shows a garden is in the shape of a trapezium.

11     Here is a trapezium drawn on a centimetre grid.
Find the area of the trapezium.
(2 marks)
